nearest_neighbors.distinction: Distinct from Volume Sampling for Matrix Approximation and Projective Clustering (`AIMech:VolumeSamplingForMatrixApproximationAndProjectiveClustering`), which analyzes the multiplicative (k+1)! ||A - A_k||_F^2 row-span projection error of simplex-volume sampling for low-rank matrix approximation and projective clustering rather than conditional L-ensemble inference, quality-diversity decompositions L_{ij} = q_i phi_i^T phi_j q_j, and the elementary symmetric polynomial DP sampler of Kulesza and Taskar (2011). Also distinct from standard unconditioned DPPs, which cannot enforce a hard cardinality budget |Y| = k.
